study: U: true-transition-residual calibration of action consistency

ACID.scope: ACID-style diagnostic; not official numerical reproduction

required_assets.trusted_cache_alternative: Must establish original scaler provenance and matching usable training blocks; no local substitute data

semantic_requirements.strict_load_missing_unexpected_keys: both empty required after allowed semantic-preserving API adaptation
semantic_requirements.action_scaler: original matching data/cache only; quantify sklearn ddof=0 vs torch helper before adopting path
semantic_requirements.restore: fresh seeded environment + full prefix replay; public state insufficient
G_prohibited_inputs: future microstep images not predicted by F
semantic_requirements.replay_policy: Repeat seed and exact prefix; patch adapter bugs only; preserve physical semantics; no real-future input leaks

0B_requirements.split_unit: Conservative exact initial-state family; all101 metadata trajectories and all derived windows together. Deduplicate exact current-state/successor-state/action inverse pairs globally.
0B_requirements.strengthened_G: same legal history and extra cal-fit labels; cal-val validation; never candidate A

candidate_and_calibration_requirements.contact_noncontact_target: half each based only on prescoring geometry/contact
candidate_and_calibration_requirements.root_seed_prefix_goal_history_and_suppor: Freeze prospective seed lists, prefix and goal rules before candidate outcomes; bounded prescoring contact selection only

B3.features: 3*16 PCA pooled observation latent + 2*10 executed past action blocks + current 10-action candidate

candidate_and_calibration_requirements.B6: same ridge capacity and alpha selection; fixed-seed root-block permutation across 24 cal-fit roots, preserving candidate source/slot; true cal-val labels
candidate_and_calibration_requirements.shuffle_seed_and_permutation: Fixed seed 270701; save actual root-block permutation

methods.O: posthoc squared_norm(G(real)-G(pred)); not deployable, not strict upper bound, not trigger

dev_requirements.low_variance_disable: sigma_c<=epsilon or sigma_goal<=epsilon; use goal-only, log occurrence; population std over shared 8-candidate pool
dev_requirements.harmful_flip: some j has true J at least delta_J better than B1-selected k, goal_j<=goal_k, inverse term reverses order; count once per root; no low e_real requirement
dev_requirements.role: method selection and diagnostic; no positive-effect requirement for independent test

test_requirements.GO_MECHANISM_REVIEW: point improvement>=0.05 and CI lower>0 vs dev-chosen best noncalibrated comparator; raw J consistent; if ridge, B6 CI lower>0; candidate-level evidence supports proposed real-domain-bias mechanism; data/semantics/budget valid
test_requirements.exclude_current_practical_benefit: CI upper<0.05 and baseline/measurement valid; no-scoring-range is INCONCLUSIVE-MEASUREMENT, not global scientific NO-GO
test_requirements.evidence_scope: Single frozen model, one training seed, short-horizon candidate selection; no paper novelty or cross-task claim

revision_basis.user_request: Run the experiment on the unattended workstation overnight; allow necessary preparation; aim for interpretable next-morning results
revision_basis.supersedes: v2 resource-absence stop and dev-positive-only test trigger

bootstrap.archive_format: pusht_expert_train.h5.zst is a zstd-compressed single HDF5 file; inspect magic, do not assume tar
bootstrap.training_data_read: HDF5 action/statistic columns stream; only selected RGB/latent frames cached
bootstrap.decoder_and_environment_only: PushT minimum stack; do not install all env extras or unrelated simulators
bootstrap.gpu_busy_response: Preserve foreign processes, wait or use otherwise idle authorized GPU; do CPU work while waiting
bootstrap.hard_deadline: T0 + 12 hours unless user supplies an earlier explicit deadline; stop launching long stages with 45min remaining

overnight_execution.process_supervision: tmux, user service or equivalent detached supervisor; logging plus exit code plus singleton run lock

dev_diagnostic_reference_only.harmful_flip_candidate_evidence: real-domain residuals and F error; F error alone does not establish U
dev_diagnostic_reference_only.U_selection: if abs(mean_R_B2-mean_R_B3)<=0.01 choose B2, else lower mean_R

required: baseline valid and full comparison set implemented
prospective roots and candidate generator frozen
U* and comparator fixed using dev only
measured estimated time plus reporting reserve fits deadline
test_execution_gate.incomplete_test_report: PARTIAL / INCONCLUSIVE; show completed n and frozen traversal order, not a full Gate result

attachment_role: Design input; user message controls authorization and supersedes v2.

implementation_decisions.root_generator: 40 control-step approach/hold; prescoring contact gap<=2, noncontact>=35; finite512 seeds per stratum; official unaltered reset goal
implementation_decisions.strong_cal_original_vs_extra_label_weigh: approximately 50/50; repeated cal-fit examples are not additional unique blocks
implementation_decisions.gross_baseline_failure_guard: nonfinite, MLP val MSE>1.5*constant, flow K4mean val MSE>2*constant; not an inverse uniqueness threshold
implementation_decisions.support_reference: 95th percentile nearest IDM-train action distance among6000 offline-audit blocks
implementation_decisions.original_data_action_time_acceptance: 1000 finite consecutive row comparisons; q95 PD kinematic-agent max-coordinate error<=.001 pixels; inspect/repair before freezing if failed
implementation_decisions.test_classification: All same-effect pools -> INCONCLUSIVE-MEASUREMENT; otherwise CI upper<.05 -> current-scope NO-GO; positive primary stats require candidate flip evidence and supported/unclipped improvements for mechanism-review classification
implementation_decisions.matched_G_gross_failure_guard: cal-val MSE>1.5*same-extra-label constant MSE -> baseline unsupported; not an inverse uniqueness threshold
implementation_decisions.GO_support_diagnostic: require at least one improved root with both U and comparator selections supported and unclipped, plus prescribed source strata report; full main pool retained
implementation_decisions.source_stratification: describe both four-candidate source restrictions using original frozen8-pool scores, never resample/drop primary roots
implementation_decisions.throughput_scheduler: At1000 updates measure process throughput; cap remaining updates using fair share of remaining wall/GPU budgets after evaluation reserve; no dev/test information; maintain original max20k caps and log all changes
implementation_decisions.TERM: request stop between complete control steps; save counters/checkpoints; independent supervisor finalizes even if worker killed
implementation_decisions.inverse_residual_units: raw environment control units in the flattened5x2 block. G trains in original F standardized coordinates, then is de-normalized at inference. e_real,e_pred,d_G,O and all B1-B6 costs use the raw coordinates. PCA/ridge action features use original standardized inputs before cal-fit feature standardization.

source_ancestry_addendum.finding: 18685 metadata episodes,185 exact initial-state families,101 distinct full trajectories per family
source_ancestry_addendum.split_rule: seed270700, 80/10/10 over185 families:148train/18val/19audit; source metadata alone insufficient ancestry evidence
source_ancestry_addendum.exact_transition_dedup: SHA256(original raw current7Dstate bytes +state after5controls7Dbytes +raw5x2 action bytes), global across train/val/audit; preserve selected history from same trajectory
source_ancestry_addendum.old_latent_cache: INVALIDATED_SOURCE_ANCESTRY_SPLIT, never used for G training
source_ancestry_addendum.initial_state_family_is_conservative_pro: Original collection ancestry not explicitly supplied, so same initial condition is treated as a common source rather than independent data.

budget_clock_policy: Cumulative original T0=2026-10-27T11:54:50Z and all prior GPU/download/disk work carried forward; no reset.
